priorityList: Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown for energy and its damage buff, ideally when energy is low.
Activate Berserk or Incarnation while Tiger's Fury is active.
Cast Convoke the Spirits during Berserk or Tiger's Fury, ideally immediately after casting a finisher.
Cast Feral Frenzy (or Frantic Frenzy) if Tiger's Fury is active and you have 2 or fewer Combo Points.
Cast Ferocious Bite for free whenever Apex Predator's Craving procs.
At 5 Combo Points, cast Primal Wrath if the bleed is refreshable or has less than 6.5 seconds remaining.
Cast Ravage (empowered Ferocious Bite) at 4 or more Combo Points whenever available.
At 4 or more Combo Points, cast Ferocious Bite if Primal Wrath is already ticking and you have the Rampant Ferocity talent.
Use Primal Wrath as your default finisher at 5 Combo Points if the primary target's bleed is already covered.
Maintain Rake on as many targets as possible (up to 5) to trigger Wildstalker Bloodseeker Vines.
Maintain Moonfire on all targets if the Lunar Inspiration talent is active.
Use Swipe (or Brutal Slash) as your primary builder when 3 or more targets are present or if Sudden Ambush is active.
Use Shred as your builder only when facing exactly 2 targets and you have 1 or fewer Combo Points.
Cast Regrowth when Predatory Swiftness is active to consume the proc and trigger Bloodseeker Vines.
